description: This line plot illustrates how the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage changes with varying values of N, ranging from 0 to 20 on the linear x-axis labeled “N”. The y-axis, labeled “AUC (%)”, scales linearly from 75 to 100. Five distinct lines represent different performance metrics or models: a blue line with circular markers, a brown line with square markers, a green line with star markers, an orange line with diamond markers, and a purple line with triangle markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94.5% when N=0, rises to 99.5% at N=5, peaks near 99.7% at N=10, then gradually declines to about 94.5% at N=20. The brown line begins at roughly 87.5% at N=0, increases to 99.5% at N=10, and then decreases to approximately 91.5% at N=20. The green line starts at about 86.5% at N=0, rises to 91.5% at N=5, continues to increase to nearly 93% at N=10, and then slightly declines to around 92% at N=20. The orange line begins at approximately 84% at N=0, increases to 93.5% at N=5, rises further to nearly 95% at N=10, and then slightly declines to about 94.5% at N=20. The purple line remains relatively flat, starting at 80% at N=0, dips slightly to 79.5% at N=5, sharply increases to a peak of 96% at N=10, then declines steadily to approximately 82% at N=20.
